title: Box city
description: A mod that lets you build a city out of boxes and smash and blast it as if you were a giant monster
body:
This mod adds a few new actions and a new inventory tab of items and blocks to make it possible to build a city scene and smash it as if you were a giant monster towering over the the city. 

Actions
 * **R** smashes buildings
 * **V** shoots a beam of nuclear fire to destroy box city
 * **C** puts you in crawl mode


If you want to have fun building a city of **boxes** and smashing it as a big **monster**, download this mod!

To install, move the .jar file into the mods folder under your .minecraft folder. If you are in windows, press the windows key and type %appdata% to find .minecraft.
